items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...they call your father Billy Moran or something like that. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Billy. ... Moran. That's what they used to.

ctx.x: Well, I think of it. Some people at times, I don't know if they just get mixed up, but they call your father Billy Moran or something like that. Yeah.
